rationale: The previous execution produced correct artifacts but failed evaluation on three checks: (1) missing join_check for rendering_npi cardinality verification, (2) show_denominators set to false instead of true, and (3) missing small_groups caveat. This revision adds the join_check step upfront to verify the many_to_one relationship before using provider attributes, sets show_denominators to true to display every rate with its denominator for transparency, and adds the small_groups caveat to communicate that group-level rates are statistically unstable below the min_group_size threshold. All other components and parameters are preserved.
changes_summary: Added join_check component to verify medical_claims.rendering_npi->providers.provider_npi cardinality before joining. Updated write_report: set show_denominators from false to true to print every rate as numerator/denominator, and added 'small_groups' to caveats list. These changes address all three evaluation failures while maintaining the complete analysis intent.
